title: JWT Inspector & Weakness Checker
description: Decode a JSON Web Token and audit it for weak secrets, alg:none, risky headers and missing claims, entirely in the browser.

title: Naive Bayes Spam Lab
description: Train an explainable Naive Bayes spam classifier in the browser, teach it new messages and evaluate it on held-out data.

title: CSP Policy Evaluator
description: Grade a Content-Security-Policy header for XSS, clickjacking and allowlist-bypass weaknesses, with concrete fixes, entirely in the browser.

title: K-Means Clustering Lab
description: Step through k-means clustering with k-means++ seeding, elbow and silhouette analysis, click-to-add points and CSV import, entirely in the browser.

title: Web Log Threat Hunter
description: Paste Apache/nginx access logs to detect SQLi, XSS, traversal, Log4Shell, scanners and brute-force bursts with per-IP risk scoring, entirely in the browser.
